content.title: Uber stock gains analyst confidence on autonomous vehicle progress
content.text: Investing.com - Citizens maintains its market outperform rating on with a $100 price target following the firm’s attendance at NVIDIA’s GTC event in San Jose, California this week. The firm’s analyst Andrew Boone attended presentations from executives at Wayve, Nuro, Waymo, and Uber, as well as discussions with NVIDIA’s product manager for autonomous vehicles and representatives from Pony.AI. Citizens also maintains a market outperform rating on Waymo parent with a $385 price target. The tech giant, with a market cap of $3.71 trillion, has delivered an 88% return over the past year, though InvestingPro data suggests the stock is currently overvalued relative to its Fair Value. According to InvestingPro Tips, Alphabet trades at a low P/E ratio relative to near-term earnings growth, with a PEG ratio of 0.82. The analyst stated the autonomous vehicle industry is at an inflection point as end-to-end models benefit from growing data and compute resources. Companies are now transitioning from solving technical problems to focusing on commercialization and scaling operations. Citizens believes Uber offers a turnkey solution with scaled demand and growing fleet operations. The firm sees Uber aggregating autonomous vehicle supply and expects 2026 to be the year of scaling operations and commercialization across multiple autonomous vehicle companies. The analyst noted Uber now provides driving data to partners while NVIDIA offers increased computing power for autonomous vehicle algorithms. Citizens maintains a neutral coverage rating on NVIDIA (NASDAQ:NVDA).In other recent news, Alphabet has maintained CEO Sundar Pichai’s annual base salary at $2,000,000, a figure unchanged since 2020, and granted new equity awards, as confirmed by the company’s board. MoffettNathanson reiterated its Buy rating on Alphabet, citing YouTube’s significant revenue generation, projected to reach $62 billion for the full year 2025. The firm estimates YouTube’s valuation at between $500 billion and $560 billion. Google, a part of Alphabet, announced the expansion of its Gemini AI features across its productivity applications, including Docs, Sheets, Slides, and Drive, aiming to automate various tasks for its AI Ultra and Pro subscribers.Additionally, Google is planning to develop a new data center in Michigan in collaboration with DTE Energy, committing to 2.7 gigawatts of new clean energy resources to support the local grid. Citizens maintained its Market Outperform rating on , highlighting a $553 billion backlog in Oracle Cloud Infrastructure demand, with a significant portion from OpenAI. The firm believes Oracle is well-positioned for the transition to the AI era through its vertical integration of AI infrastructure with its database and cloud applications.
